Hi Markus / Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick onboarding checklist during the pilot. Attaching our completed W-9 and articles of incorporation so procurement can proceed. A couple notes up front:

- Our EIN is 12-3456789 (listed on the W-9).
- We can provide a company registry extract and a bank letter if helpful.

Procurement asked whether Redwood accepts a "live video" identity check instead of notarized apostilles for U.S. entities. We're happy to hop on a short video to confirm an exec's photo ID + corporate documents if that speeds things up. Proposed times tomorrow (Mon): 10:00am or 2:00pm PT.

Files attached: Cleasail_W-9_signed.pdf (pdf), Clearsail_Articles_of_Incorp.pdf (pdf)

Let us know preferred slot and any special verifier details (e.g., company rep name or ID format).

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the files. I pulled the attachment and did a quick check; W-9 looks signed and EIN format matches.

Procurement (cc Kimberly + Laura) has two asks before we can issue a PO:
1) Procurement requires one of the following verified evidence items for a U.S. entity: notarized W-9, bank letter showing legal name + EIN, or a 3-way live video verification where we confirm (a) exec photo ID, (b) company incorporation docs, and (c) a live statement on company letterhead.
2) The video verification needs to be recorded (30–60 seconds) and uploaded to our secure onboarding portal; please confirm consent to recording in your reply.

If you can do video, Kimberly can run the session and confirm for the PO gate. Otherwise we can accept a bank letter (PDF) issued within the last 90 days.

Proposed times I can join: Mon 10:00am PT works. Kimberly — can you lead the session and handle the recording? Laura — FYI for PO timeline.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference

- Please confirm the name and title of the person who will join (must be authorized signer).
